name: Ritual — cour du temple
variant: Gears 5 — Ritual, cour adaptée au combat latéral
prompt: Create ONE opaque landscape 16:9 static 2D HD fighting-game stage master faithfully reconstructing the Ritual multiplayer map courtyard from Gears 5, using the attached final production screenshot as the concrete architectural/material reference. Not a collage. A wide level side-facing composition, camera horizontal at modest standing height, and an uninterrupted broad horizontal strip of worn mossy stone courtyard paving spanning the bottom 22% for fighters to stand on. Recompose the camera and foreground for this game-stage use, but preserve this exact place's distinctive identity: massive ancient gnarled dark tree occupying the left third, twisting limb crossing overhead; hazy narrow stepped temple towers in rear center; at right the huge fixed carved ceremonial winged beaklike idol with dark oxidized green, reddish ochre and tarnished gold details upon its heavily carved rectangular stone pedestal. The idol is a stationary monument, not a living enemy. Preserve the photographed organic tree contours, relief motifs, vines, scattered ferns, deep ochre-green haze, bright yellow backlit jungle canopy and very small distant temple flames. Keep the playable foreground unobstructed and near-horizontal, all pillars, roots and pedestals behind its rear edge. Exceptional tactile stone and bark detail with the grounded visual language of the supplied Gears 5 scene, a polished dark 2D painted environment. NO people, soldiers, creatures, enemies, weapons, loot, HUD, labels, logos, credits, borders or watermark; remove the entire portfolio footer from the reference. One continuous background, no split panels, no animation frames, no isolated layers. Do not invent modern buildings or generic fantasy decoration.

sources.scope: Capture finale de la cour de Ritual dans Gears 5, publiée par le lead level artist de la carte.

observations: Grand arbre noueux à gauche, tour du temple dans la brume et monument ailé à bec sur piédestal à droite repris de la capture finale; palette jaune-olive et reliefs vert-rouge conservés.
Un seul décor opaque avec bande de sol horizontale continue; aucun personnage, ennemi mobile, interface ou crédit visible.
Sol de combat et hauteur de caméra recomposés. Les reliefs du monument, les proportions de sa couronne et les racines sont réinterprétés; leur fidélité géométrique exacte n’est pas validée.
remaining_checks: Comparer les motifs du monument et la largeur du piédestal aux captures finales sous plusieurs angles.
Valider l’échelle des combattants et la hauteur de la bande de sol avant intégration jouable.
